lines.text: Is shehar mein, tumhare Class 10 ke marks, hamesha tumhare sar ke upar tairte hain.
Samose wale chacha. Chhiyalis percent. Par samose, sau percent.
Shaadi mein bhi, aunty pehle number dekhti hain. Phir ladka.
Isliye Papa ne aaj tak, ghar mein bhi helmet nahi utaara.
Aur Mummy ka number? Nabbe percent. Isliye ghar mein unki chalti hai.
Aur Kabir? Uske sar ke upar, abhi sirf ek sawaal hai.
Kyunki boards mein, abhi nabbe din baaki hain.
Number fix hone se pehle, Kabir ne Zeta pe apna plan banaya. Roz ek mission.
Aur pehli baar, sawaal ke neeche, kuch dikhne laga.
Tumhare sar ke upar abhi kya likha hota? Comment karo.
